assumptions_and_limitations: Brownian generator D Delta in any finite dimension, Poisson rate lambda, scalar iid reset U in [0,1] with positive chance of contraction, radial variance-gamma target. No claim about non-Poisson, anisotropic, state-dependent or general contraction kernels. Classical beta-gamma algebra is an ingredient; priority against all general perpetuity literature is not independently established.
scientific_integrity: Analytic inverse classification with exact moment comparison, constructive beta identity, and existence/uniqueness by contraction; finite numerical and arithmetic tests are corroborative only.
title: Inverse design of multivariate variance-gamma equilibria by random Brownian resetting
